Ketchup.subject: Indian Languages
Ketchup.question: The term was anglicized to caveach, a word first attested in the late _____th century, at the same time as ketchup
Ketchup.fact: The term was anglicized to caveach, a word first attested in the late 17th century, at the same time as ketchup. The word entered the English language in Britain during the late 17th century, appearing in print as ketchup (1682), catchup (1690), and later as catsup (1730).

Ketchup.subject: Indian Languages
Ketchup.question: Water is a large part of ketchup, due to it being _____ of the composition of distilled vinegar
Ketchup.fact: Water is a large part of ketchup, due to it being 80% of the composition of distilled vinegar.
